SET nums TO [5, 2, 4, 1]
SET n TO LENGTH(nums)
FOR i FROM 0 TO n - 2 DO
    SET swapped TO False
    FOR j FROM 0 TO n - 1 - i - 1 DO
        IF nums[j] > nums[j + 1] THEN
            # swap the two values using temp
            SET temp TO nums[j]
            SET nums[j] TO nums[j + 1]
            SET nums[j + 1] TO temp
            SET swapped TO True
        END IF
    END FOR
    IF NOT swapped THEN
        break  [!]
    END IF
END FOR
SEND nums TO DISPLAY
